Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 훈련의 실패를 만회하고 싶어 한다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> wants to make up for her failed training. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングの失敗を挽回したいと思っている。何と声をかけようか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>想挽回训练的失败。该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>想挽回訓練的失敗。該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> veut se rattraper de son entraînement raté. Que devrais-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> möchte ihr gescheitertes Training wiedergutmachen. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quiere compensar su entrenamiento fallido. ¿Qué le digo?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quer compensar a falha no treino. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> อยากจะแก้ไขความผิดพลาดจากการฝึกซ้อม ควรจะพูดว่าอะไรดี?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ingin menebus kegagalan latihannya. Apa yang harus kukatakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> muốn bù đắp cho buổi huấn luyện thất bại. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अपनी असफल ट्रेनिंग की भरपाई करना चाहती है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 아니, 오늘은 이만 쉬는 게 좋겠어.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: No, I think we should take a break today.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: いや、今日はもう休もう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 不，今天还是休息比较好。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 不，今天還是休息比較好。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Non, je pense que nous devrions faire une pause aujourd'hui.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Nein, ich denke, wir sollten heute eine Pause machen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No, creo que hoy deberíamos descansar.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não, acho que devemos fazer uma pausa hoje.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่ล่ะ วันนี้พักผ่อนดีกว่าค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Tidak, kurasa sebaiknya kita istirahat saja hari ini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không, tôi nghĩ hôm nay chúng ta nên nghỉ ngơi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: नहीं, मुझे लगता है कि आज हमें आराम करना चाहिए।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: All right. Let's give it another try.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: In Ordnung. Geben wir uns mehr Mühe.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Tudo bem. Vamos nos esforçar mais.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: เอาล่ะ ลองพยายามอีกครั้งค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Baiklah. Mari kita berusaha lebih keras lagi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được rồi. Cố gắng thêm lần nữa nào.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है। चलो एक और कोशिश करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบโพชั่นพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa Bình Thuốc Hồi Phục Sức Sống.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió terminar el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกซ้อมและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk mengakhiri latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने ट्रेनिंग बंद करके आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecía seguir insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ดูเหมือน <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังไม่พอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, nhưng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> volvió a intentar el entrenamiento y obtuvo buenos resultados.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e alcançou bons resultados.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยายามอีกครั้งและทำผลงานได้ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber noch einmal.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero falló.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยายามอีกครั้งแต่ก็ล้มเหลวอีก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại nhưng lại thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se alegró al recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã vui vẻ hơn sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> औषधि मिलने के बाद खुश हो गई।
